properties.name: WHAT WORKED, re-measured on 0.77.0 (2026-10-02): through --call, export_graph refuses an existing path until "overwrite": true. import_graph writes a hand-built 110-node/140-edge document in one call (0.30 s, nothing skipped). An import with an invalid node is refused whole, every bad item listed, nothing written. Do not regress it. One qualification: an edge to a node in neither the document nor the graph is SKIPPED with exit 0, not refused
properties.statement:
From the "Measured" table of art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02 (rows: "--call export_graph to an existing path: refused until overwrite: true"; "--call import_graph of a hand-built document (about 110 nodes, 140 edges): written in one call, nothing skipped; a refused import writes nothing"). Re-measured by triage agent D: 0.77.0, scratch stores, isolated HOME. Log /home/ajs7/.claude/jobs/fa666a94/tmp/triage-D/measure.log. Documents: triage-D/hand-110*.json.

EXPORT, HOLDS:
- export_graph {path} to a new file: exit 0, 69,462 bytes, 110 nodes, 140 edges, 0.12 s.
- The same path again: exit 1, "... already exists — refusing to overwrite it. Pass overwrite=true to replace it, or choose a path that does not exist."
- With overwrite:true: exit 0, same content_hash.

IMPORT, HOLDS:
- A hand-built document (30 Requirements, 40 Capabilities, 20 Components, 20 Decisions; 40 SATISFIES, 40 ALLOCATED_TO, 60 GOVERNED_BY) with prose holding apostrophes, quotes, an em dash, CJK and a newline. import_graph {path} into an empty store: exit 0, 0.30 s, nodes_written 110, edges_written 140, skipped_edges [], plus a provenance_note that the document was unstamped.
- The same document with one Decision status "bogus-status": exit 1, "4 item(s) in this document are invalid, and NOTHING was written — the import is all-or-nothing". It lists the bad enum with its legal values, and the three edges that then lose their endpoint. graph_report afterwards shows node_counts [] (nothing written).

THE QUALIFICATION, measured: the valid document plus one edge to req:missing (in neither document nor store) imports with exit 0. nodes_written 110, edges_written 140, and skipped_edges ["SATISFIES cap:c0 -> req:missing (endpoint not in the document or the graph)"]. So the report's "nothing skipped" is a check the agent has to read from skipped_edges; exit 0 does not mean every edge landed.

Related, for limitation 2: export_graph is annotated readOnlyHint=true and writes a file at any path, overwrite included (fact:root-cause-one-regex-cannot-separate-door-reads-because-the-read-set-is-not-in-the-command-and-not-served-2026-10-02).
